Title: Excellent room temperature ductility of as-cast TRIP high-entropy alloy via Mo and C alloying
Primary_Reason: Five as-cast chemistry variants within one controlled study; direct 40%-strain EBSD deformation-twin evidence for C2/C2Mo1/C2Mo2; author-attributed TRIP behavior for C0; useful C/Mo chemistry perturbation around Fe50Mn30Co10Cr10.
